sourceNotes: The official homepage is https://medicalcannabis.utah.gov/, the Utah Department of Health and Human Services Center for Medical Cannabis. On 2026-09-08 the host answered a browser-headed fetch with the live medical program pages, so fetch is enough and requires_browser is false. The site is medical-only: adults participate by getting a medical cannabis card and buying at licensed medical cannabis pharmacies. Cultivation is licensed production overseen with the Utah Department of Agriculture and Food at https://medicalcannabis.utah.gov/production/; the patient pages never describe home grow and tell cardholders to use only pharmacy-bought medical cannabis. The previously stored recreational citation on le.utah.gov was replaced because this re-research answered that question from the requested host.
